lines: We present the first controlled within-family per-example analysis of how attention affects cross-architecture agreement in hybrid recurrent models. Figure~\ref{fig:decoupling} previews our central finding: architectures that appear equivalent by aggregate benchmarks diverge systematically at the per-example level, and this divergence is established by minimal attention.
